overview: This Senate resolution honors the life and legacy of Lou Holtz, the longtime college football coach. It recounts his career as head coach at six schools, including the University of Notre Dame and the University of South Carolina, his record of turning losing programs into winning ones, his induction into the College Football Hall of Fame, his later work as a television analyst, and his receipt of the Presidential Medal of Freedom. The Senate honors his dedication to college football, his mentoring of players, and his emphasis on character and teamwork. It was approved by voice vote on March 16, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution recognizes a coach who mentored hundreds of young athletes and stressed character and hard work.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
